title: Review grading evidence
intro: Review the grading state and the evidence before applying or delivering grades.

steps.review: Finals show the snapshot used to draft the assessment. Source holds need investigation before a score is applied.
steps.verify: Read the snapshot beside the feedback, then check the proposal and denominator. At phone width, scroll the source without obscuring the decision controls.
steps.say: Finals show the snapshot used to draft the assessment. Source holds need investigation before a score is applied.
